tasks.title: Audit, Purge Non-Whitelisted Table Methods & Enforce 30-Function Boundary
tasks.description: Audit src/managers/TableManager.js, src/core/PPTXTemplater.js, and index.d.ts. Purge any table-related methods, legacy aliases, or extraneous routines that are not in the exact 30-function whitelist under the 'Tables' category. Ensure only these 30 functions are exposed in runtime delegates, interfaces, and public classes.

tasks.title: Implement Table Lifecycle, Query & Cloning Engine
tasks.description: Implement addTable, updateTable, updateTableData, removeTable, getTables, getTable, and cloneTable. Manage DrawingML table elements (<a:tbl>), non-visual group properties, graphic frame containers (<p:graphicFrame>), position transforms (<a:xfrm>), and slide context delegation. Support percentage and EMU coordinates while maintaining fluent chaining returning this.

tasks.title: Implement Row & Column Structural Manipulation & Data I/O
tasks.description: Implement addTableRow, addTableColumn, removeTableRow, removeTableColumn, updateRowData, updateColumnData, clearRowData, clearColumnData, getRowData, getColumnData, getRow, and getColumn. Handle dynamic grid re-calculations (<a:tblGrid>, <a:gridCol>), row height distributions (<a:tr h="...">), cell node shifts, and clean data updates without schema corruption.

tasks.title: Implement Cell-Level Operations, Clear & Data Accessors
tasks.description: Implement updateTableCell, clearCellData, getTableData, getCell, and getCellData. Ensure cell text bodies (<a:txBody>), paragraph runs (<a:p>, <a:r>, <a:t>), and coordinate lookups accurately handle empty cells, multiline content, and non-destructive data clearing while preserving underlying formatting.

tasks.title: Implement Complex Cell Merging & Splitting Subsystem
tasks.description: Implement mergeCells(tableId, startRow, startColumn, endRow, endColumn) and splitCell(tableId, rowIndex, columnIndex). Correctly generate OpenXML rowSpan/gridSpan attributes and horizontal/vertical merge tags (rowSpan, gridSpan, hMerge, vMerge) on <a:tc>, adjust adjacent cell references, and support un-merging/splitting back into independent matrix cells.

tasks.title: Implement Comprehensive Multi-Tier Styling Engine
tasks.description: Implement styleTable, styleColumn, styleRow, and styleCell. Map styling options (borders, cell backgrounds/solid fills, fonts, font size, colors, alignments, margins) cleanly to DrawingML table properties (<a:tblPr>), cell properties (<a:tcPr>), text body properties (<a:tcTxStyle>, <a:txBody>), and border elements (<a:lnL>, <a:lnR>, <a:lnT>, <a:lnB>).

tasks.title: Executable Showcase Script, Documentation & Workspace Sync
tasks.description: Create showcase/table_advanced.js demonstrating all 30 approved methods with console logs, JSDoc, and inline comments. Update docs-site/src/data/apiReference.json under 'Tables' to feature exclusively the 30 functions, update README.md, and sync .agent/ memory files.
